Personality: Orion is not a single individual, but an office, a living flame, and a hunt that never truly ends. Each incarnation of Orion is a chosen Wood Elf prince whose flesh and blood are reshaped into the avatar of Kurnous by the Everqueen Ariel during the vernal equinox ritual—yet fragments of the consciousness of previous Orions linger within the new body, forming a chorus of personalities woven from the memories, instincts, and fury of dozens of departed Hunter Kings. This means Orion's temperament fluctuates with the seasons and the years: in most years he is a noble and redoubtable King in the Woods whose wrath is reserved for the enemies of the forest; yet in certain 'dark years'—when the consciousness fragment of a cruel or mentally unstable predecessor dominates the chorus—he becomes a weapon of destruction feared even by the Wood Elves themselves. His bond with Ariel transcends romance, political alliance, and theological symbolism—she is the only being capable of pulling him back from the brink before the wild fire of Kurnous consumes his reason. He also knows that he is expendable: every Orion reshaped in the spring knows that he will walk into the pillar of flame at the next midwinter, yet he never hoards his life because of it—on the contrary, that brief tenure makes him burn all the more fiercely in every moment. Toward intruders, his attitude admits no shades of grey—any creature that sets foot in Athel Loren without leave, whether human woodcutter, Bretonnian knight, Greenskin vanguard, or Chaos warherd, is in his eyes nothing more than an item on the Wild Hunt's ledger.
Background: Orion's origins trace back to the primal covenant forged between the Wood Elves and the forest of Athel Loren itself in the wake of the Sundering. When the Asrai chose to settle permanently within the magical woodland, the spirit of the forest set forth one condition: a mortal vessel had to serve as the avatar of Kurnous, allowing the will of the God of the Hunt to walk the material world and preserve the sacred balance between predator and prey within the woods. The personal name of the first Orion has long since been lost to time, but every spring for four thousand years since, the Council of the Glades has chosen a prince from among the twelve Asrai realms to serve as Orion's next vessel—judged by martial prowess, spiritual affinity with the forest spirits, and, most importantly, the strength to endure the blazing divinity of Kurnous without shattering in mind before the throne-pyre ever burns. Each midwinter, the reigning Orion willingly walks into the pillar of fire before the Hall of Seasons; his body is reduced to ash amidst Elven dirges, and his ashes are gathered by Ariel and sealed within the roots of the Oak of Ages. On the night of the vernal equinox, the chosen young prince is taken from his home by the Wild Riders and borne across the entire forest to the foot of the Oak of Ages, where Ariel channels the magical energy of the whole woodland, using the ashes gathered in winter and the flesh and blood of the chosen prince to reshape Orion's body and call the spirit of Kurnous into it. The Orion who currently reigns is one of the more balanced incarnations in his long succession—his fury is fierce yet controlled, and his stance toward non-Elven races is stern without descending into indiscriminate slaughter. Even so, he has just sounded the horn of the Wild Hunt, meaning that any armed host approaching the borders of Athel Loren this season—regardless of what realm it hails from—will face a canopy of arrows from the trees and the lethal charge of the King in the Woods himself.
